content: Isar uwafes zinda
Dórmor din šeš oi zaigoi bade, Mogdaleni Moriyam, Yakubor ma Moriyam, edde Salomi, hitara Isar lašot ḍoli dito zaibolla kušbo tel kinne.
Bade haftar foila din binna kub sore, zẽtte hitara hoboror hãse giye hẽtte beil uiṭṭe.
Hitara ekzone ekzonore hodde, "Hoboror mukottu fattorguware ãra hare diyore šoraiyum?"
Kintu hitara saiyore dekedde fattorguwa šoraiya. Hiba beši ḍõr aššil.
Hoboror butore goli hitara dola lamba hor finda ekzon zuwan manušore den ḍakottu boiṛa deikke, henot hitara beši ammuwak oiye.
Kintu hite hodde, "Ammuwak no oiyo, kurušot diya oiyede Nasarator Isare ze tũwara tuwor, hiba eṛe nai, hiba uṛi giyegoi. So, iyan he zaga ziyanot hitara hibare rakkil.
Ar tũwara zo, hibar sahabi okkolore edde Fitorore hogoi ze Hiba tũwarar age Galilot zar. Hibaye zendilla hoil he bafe tũwara heṛe hibar deha faiba."
Toi hitara kissu buzi uṛi no fari ḍore hafi hafi hoborottu niyoli giyegoi edde hentu dai giyegoi. Hitara ei babute ek or hota o honokiyore no ho, kiyollahoile hitara ḍorai gilgoi.
Isaye Sahabi okkolore deha diye
Haftar foila din binna sore, Isa abar uṛizaigoi bade hibaye foila Mogdaleni Moriyamore deha diye, zibattu Isaye hãttuwa but dafail.
Hibaye hentu giyegoi edde he hóborgan zara Isar fũwati takito, hitarare diye edde hitara hainde edde bilag gorat aššil.
Kintu hitara zehon fuinne, ze Isa zinda ase edde hibare deha diye, hitara hiyan biššaš no gore.
In okkol goṭi bade, Isaye oinno ruf dori hitarar dui zonore fõtot deha diye, zara baire farat zadde aššil.
Itara o uwafes firi giye edde dusoragunore o he hóbor diye, kintu hitarare o hitara biššaš no gore.

Šeše hiba he egarozon asabe hána háibolla dola oiyede šomot hitarare deha diye. Biššašor obaf edde dil dorode hiyanolla hitarare hibaye boka diye, kiyollahoile hiba uṛizaigoi bade zara hibare deikke hitarar hota itara biššaš no gore.
Isar šeš hokum
Isaye hitarare hodde,"Duniyair hár mikka zo edde Allar diya kušir hobor hár manuš zatir hãse tobolig goro.
Ze honokiye biššaš gore edde torikotor gusol lo hite uddar faibo. Kintu ze biššaš no goribo, hitare duši ṭora oibo.
Zara biššaš gore hitarar butore ei sinnogun deha zaibo: Ãr name hitara bod ruh dafaibo, hitarar zile noya bášat hota hoibo,
ar hitara hate háf doribo, zodi hitara hono moron biš há, toile hitarar hono hoti no oibo. Ar zẽtte hitara biyaraimmar gat hat rakibo, hitara bala oi zaiboi."
Isare asmanot tuli loiza oiye
Malik Isaye hitarar loi hota hoi bade, hibare asmanot tuli loi za oiye edde Allar den ḍakottu boišše.
Toi sahabi okkol baire giye edde hár zagat tobolig goijje. Ar Malike hitarar fũwati ham gorat taikke edde hitarare keramoti ham goribar šokti diyore forman goijje ze hibar kalam soiyi. Amen!
